description: Tri Delta's annual themed winter function. The theme this year is Spotify WrappeDDD - members and guests will dress up as their top artist on Spotify Wrapped, or their favorite artist. There will be catering and a cash bar.

name: International Childhood Cancer Awareness Day
description: Tri Delta members will promote International Childhood Cancer Awareness Day on February 12 by tabling outside the library, passing out bracelets, ribbons, and flowers to students and faculty on campus, and will fundraise online through social media. International Childhood Cancer Awareness Day is on February 15, but Tri Delta members will promote it on campus on February 12 instead. Any fundraising done or donations given will go to towards Tri Delta's national philanthropy, St. Jude!
